expect: a new bullet ends the unit, so cues do not leak across items

name: the identifier vocabulary stops being derived from the checkboxes, so a new item family is invisible — neither checked nor reported unknown

out.update(f"{prefix}{n}" for n in range(a, b))
expect: a range written B1-5 with the prefix on one side still covers the TOP member

name: two copies of one item with different marks stop conflicting, so the roadmap and the checklist can disagree forever and one of them is lying
edits: if ident in marks and marks[ident] != mark:
expect: two copies of one item with different marks conflict

name: named_but_done stops firing, so NEXT ACTIONS can present a ticked item as work still to do — the whole reason this script exists

name: unresolvable stops firing, so a renamed or mistyped identifier is silently accepted as a real next step

name: an in-progress [~] item stops counting as remaining, so a plan can go green in the middle of its own work

return sorted(i for i, m in marks.items() if m in (" ",))
expect: an in-progress [~] item still counts as remaining, so naming nothing FAILS
